assignment_notes.acc_accounts_category: Availability/reporting metadata: it describes the filing/reporting regime and is not a financial value.
assignment_notes.acc_current_ratio: Financial position/scale: it is a dimensionless financial ratio, not a timing field.
assignment_notes.acc_employee_band: Financial position/scale: it measures workforce scale despite categorical encoding.
assignment_notes.acc_employees_unit_anomaly: Availability/reporting metadata: it is a parser/reporting diagnostic and is not financial content.
assignment_notes.observation_indicators: All missing__acc_* indicators remain in every ablation baseline. For logical permutation blocks they move with their owning raw feature to preserve the null pattern; source-presence and reporting-only fields form separate availability blocks.

difference_reporting.bootstrap_mean: diagnostic only and explicitly labelled when shown
difference_reporting.point_estimate: observed difference from unrounded held-out metrics

permutation.missingness_policy: For logical and content-group permutations, an observation indicator moves with its owning raw feature. The broad availability/reporting diagnostic instead permutes source presence, observation indicators and reporting-only metadata together while holding content fixed; it is overlapping and non-additive, and its counterfactual combinations are not interpreted causally.
permutation.variability: mean and sample standard deviation across seeded permutations; not a confidence interval over companies

contents.reason: The held-out results were inspected before this accounts ablation and importance analysis was specified. Results are exploratory and cannot be used as confirmatory model-selection evidence.

pairing.archive_timing_note: Accounts registration-month availability is distinct from monthly ZIP publication/download time; this does not claim the ZIP existed at month-end.
pairing.rule: Register is dated the first day of T+1; PSC is the latest available snapshot on or before that date; accounts rows were available in registration month <= T.
